description: List the files in an inbox's drive (Agent Drive) in path order, optionally only those under a path prefix such as reports/. Results carry no download link; get_file returns one. A file created or deleted in the last second may not show yet. Agent Drive is in AgentMail Labs (US only); an organization outside Labs gets a 403.

inboxId.description: Inbox ID: the inbox's email address, from list_inboxes

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous page's result; omit for the first page

pathPrefix.description: Only files whose path starts with this, e.g. reports/ (it matches characters, so reports/q matches reports/q3.pdf)
